# Cognika

> Cognika is a cognitive engineering and intelligent systems initiative. It
> develops cognitive intelligence for agentic solutions, intelligent software
> and industrial systems. Its approach begins with understanding the problem:
> clarifying ideas, objectives, requirements and constraints before turning
> them into intelligent solutions.

Cognika's central idea is bringing cognition into artificial intelligence:
creating a cognitive layer between human intention and artificial
intelligence. Rather than treating AI as a question-and-answer interface,
Cognika aims to provide a medium through which people can develop, clarify and
implement their ideas using intelligent agents.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cognika.tech/): Positioning, the approach in brief, and the three projects.
- [About Cognika](https://cognika.tech/about/): The cognitive approach and the four-step method: Understand, Structure, Reason, Implement.
- [Projects](https://cognika.tech/projects/): Overview of e_os, pat_ia and Srm_p.
- [Contact](https://cognika.tech/contact/): How to get in touch.

## Projects

- [e_os](https://cognika.tech/e-os/): Elevator Operating System. An intelligent
  elevator dispatch system that learns building traffic patterns, evaluates
  service performance and optimizes elevator operation, supported by a
  dedicated AI agent.
  Status: tested in simulation and progressing toward on-site testing. Not
  deployed in operational buildings.

- [pat_ia](https://cognika.tech/pat-ia/): An intelligent, self-implementing
  business system. Explores an approach to enterprise resource planning built
  on cognitive intelligence and agentic automation rather than predefined
  workflows.
  Status: project concept. Not a completed or commercially available product.

- [Srm_p](https://cognika.tech/srm-p/): Synchronous Reluctance Motor
  development. Explores rotor and stator configurations, electromagnetic
  performance, torque characteristics and energy efficiency. The current design
  work concerns a four-pole synchronous reluctance positioning motor: 150 mm
  rotor diameter, 100 mm stack length, 3 N-m target starting torque, 1,000 rpm
  maximum operating speed, inverter-fed.
  Status: under electromagnetic design and simulation. The figures are design
  targets and simulated results, not measured hardware performance.

## Notes for agents

- Pages are server-rendered HTML. JavaScript is not required to read them.
- The three projects are at different maturity levels. Do not represent a
  concept or a simulation result as a shipped product or a measured
  performance figure.
- No social profiles, telephone numbers or postal addresses are published.
